source.dataset_title: Long-term monitoring of Azorean forest arthropods: the BALA Project (1997-2022)

why_candidate_is_special.published_description: the same core sites were repetitively sampled in BALA1, BALA2 and BALA3 under the BALA protocol
why_candidate_is_special.sampling_protocol: 150 m transect; 30 pitfall traps at 5 m intervals using alternating preservative solutions plus beating of the three most prevalent native tree species

metadata_inconsistencies_that_must_be_re: description says 30 identical core sites whereas Project Data text also says 31 core sites
description gives BALA2 as 2010-2012 whereas Study Extent gives 2010-2011
Project Data text gives later round as 2021-2022 whereas Study Extent gives BALA3 as 2019-2022
geographic coverage lists eight islands for the enriched full dataset whereas the core repeated panel is described as seven islands

may_open_first: archive member names, sizes and hashes
Event core fields needed to reconstruct sampling phase, transect/site, fragment, island, date, coordinates, method and core-panel membership
must_remain_semantically_unopened: any source-loss or t2 contraction statistic
file_role_firewall.event_core_role: response-independent repeated-panel identity and sampling-effort audit

core_panel_gate.required_result: one deterministic set of repeatedly sampled core transects/sites present under comparable BALA methodology in all three phases

three_wave_mapping.t0: BALA1 core panel after Event-only audit
three_wave_mapping.t1: BALA2 core panel after Event-only audit
three_wave_mapping.t2: BALA3 core panel after Event-only audit
three_wave_mapping.calendar_ranges: not frozen from prose; exact phase membership must come from raw Event metadata

taxon_partition_problem.reason: there is only one three-wave temporal sequence, so a burned pilot and confirmation cannot be made temporally disjoint
taxon_partition_problem.required_solution: freeze a deterministic disjoint taxon partition before semantic occurrence access
taxon_partition_problem.preferred_partition: hash partition on a stable taxon identifier or normalized scientific-name token whose exact field and normalization are fixed after meta.xml/header audit but before occurrence rows are semantically parsed
taxon_partition_problem.pilot_role: estimability and response-quality audit only; no source-leverage effect estimate
taxon_partition_problem.confirmatory_role: remains sealed until v0.31/v0.42/v0.32/v0.33 and full source-loss protocol are frozen
taxon_partition_problem.opaque_transport_requirement: routing may inspect only the frozen routing token needed to copy rows into pilot versus confirmatory byte surfaces and may not summarize event-by-taxon occurrence combinations for confirmatory taxa

provisional_endpoint.spatial_state_level: island-by-taxon-by-BALA-phase, aggregated only from the frozen repeated core panel
provisional_endpoint.presence: at least one eligible core-panel occurrence in that island-phase
provisional_endpoint.surveyed_zero: no eligible occurrence for the taxon on an island-phase only after Event metadata establishes the frozen repeated sampling effort on that island-phase
provisional_endpoint.claim_ceiling: observed occurrence in repeatedly sampled native-forest core sites, not whole-island extinction

taxonomic_scope_firewall.metadata_statement: Acari and Collembola were excluded from collection; Diptera and Hymenoptera other than Formicidae were not separated to morphospecies
taxonomic_scope_firewall.primary_taxa_rule: eligible focal taxa must have a stable species/morphospecies identity that is prospectively crosswalkable across all three BALA phases

stop_conditions: raw Event data do not resolve a stable core panel across all three phases
fewer than five islands remain in the repeated core panel
phase membership requires occurrence outcomes to reconstruct
stable taxon routing cannot be defined before semantic confirmatory occurrence access
confirmatory event-by-taxon occurrence combinations are summarized during routing
surveyed zero cannot be distinguished from missing or incomparable sampling effort
